name: sdl-r2-staging-gate
normalizationNotes: Cloudflare plain_text SUPABASE_URL maps to the cf config's JSON primitive wrapper. Inspected pinned config adapter maps binding.value to vars; deploy adapter emits strings as plain_text.
secret_text maps to secret binding declarations only. No secret values were requested, retrieved or saved.
SUBMISSIONS_ENABLED is absent in the deployed v1 Worker; adding the candidate's false value is the existing intentional default-off rollout change.

routeReview.method: Candidate leaves domains/triggers/routes unset. Reviewed pinned cf 1.0.0-rc.0 only invokes route/domain mutations for configured nonempty route lists. Preserve unmanaged existing routes; never invent a route inventory.
